newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick Gold files for US$1 bln debt issue.
newsitem.headline: Barrick Gold files for US$1 bln debt issue.

text.p: Barrick Gold Corp and its subsidiary, Barrick Gold Finance Inc, said on Tuesday that they filed for a US$1 billion issue of non-convertible debt securities.

Barrick filed a preliminary short-form prospectus with the Ontario Securities Commission and a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to qualify and register the issue, the company said.
"These securities may be issued, from time to time over a two-year period, by Barrick or its subsidiary, Barrick Gold Finance Inc," Barrick said.
Barrick spokesman Vince Borg said the filing is not related to any acquisition plans.
"Basically, it is a refinancing vehicle," he said in a telephone interview.
Barrick drew about US$500 million from its US$1 billion credit line to help pay for the US$800 million acquisition of gold prospector Arequipa Resources Ltd last year, Borg said.
